kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.definition: Trailing-twelve-month revenue growth versus the prior year.

kpis.label: Free-cash-flow margin
kpis.definition: Free cash flow as a share of revenue.

kpis.label: Capital expenditure
kpis.definition: Capital expenditure as a share of revenue.

kpis.label: Cash runway
kpis.definition: Cash and investments divided by the absolute trailing free-cash-flow burn. Not meaningful when free cash flow is positive.

kpis.label: Revenue mix disclosure
kpis.definition: No segment split disclosed. A single consolidated line is not treated as a segment split.
